title: Off the Beaten Track: Southern Africa
description: Southern Africa at full scale, from Cape Town to the Serengeti, built around you by the Off the Beaten Track app (offthebeatentrack.world, built on BeamNG.Earth). Start the app, then pick a city below or teleport from the map. Preview: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016 by EOX IT Services GmbH (CC BY 4.0).
biome: Savanna, bushveld, Kalahari and Namib desert, Drakensberg mountains, Okavango wetlands, coast and lakes
roads: Every road in ten countries: highways, city streets, gravel roads, mountain passes and 4x4 tracks
suitablefor: Overlanding, 4x4 trails, road trips, exploring, freeroam
features: Real terrain, roads, passes, towns and live weather across South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Zambia, Mozambique, Lesotho, Eswatini, Malawi and Tanzania
authors: Off the Beaten Track (built on BeamNG.Earth)

spawnPoints.description: The last place you teleported to.
A road somewhere in Southern Africa, picked at random each time.
